metadata.title: ESSAI DE MÉCANIQUE CHIMIQUE FONDÉE SUR LA THERMOCHIMIE

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features a high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal serifs, which are characteristic of the Modern/Didone style popular in 19th-century academic and formal publishing.
